name: Kemei KM-809A Rechargeable Hair Clipper and Trimmer for Men
description:
Kemei KM-809A Rechargeable Electric Trimmer

Professional Hair Clipper & Grooming Set for Men, Women, and Pets

Description

Why visit the salon when you can achieve a professional trim at home? The Kemei KM-809A is a heavy-duty rechargeable trimmer designed for versatile use—whether it’s men’s styling, women’s grooming, or even pet care. Equipped with stainless steel blades, long battery life, and multiple attachments, this trimmer delivers quick, efficient, and safe results every time.

Specifications

Brand / Model: Kemei KM-809A

Color: White (multicolor accents)

Type: Hair Clipper / Grooming Set

Blade Material: Stainless Steel

Power: 12W, Rechargeable

Battery: 1000mAh Lithium-ion

Voltage: 100V–240V (universal)

Switch Type: Push switch

Charging Time: 4 hours

Working Time: Up to 240 minutes (cordless)

Net Weight: 260 g (Product weight: 0.365 kg)

Product Size: 18.5 × 4.5 cm

Cable Length: 1.3 m

Package Weight: 0.535 kg

Package Size: 14.3 × 6.6 × 23.6 cm (5.63 × 2.6 × 9.29 in)

Key Features ✨

Four interchangeable comb attachments for different hair lengths

LCD display showing remaining battery capacity

Intelligent noise reduction for quiet operation

Safe and efficient trimming—cuts smoothly like combing hair

Suitable for men, women, and pets
